purpose: Fail-closed runtime and transferred-code attestation for the CPU-only PCQM4Mv2 release worker. This contract records an observed environment; compatibility is admitted only by a separate golden-record gate.

canonical_json.object_key_order: lexicographic Unicode code-point order as emitted by Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True)
canonical_json.output_creation: exclusive-create; an existing target must never be replaced

e3fp_source_closure.symlink_policy: reject every symlink below the package root
e3fp_source_closure.closure_digest: SHA-256 of canonical JSON encoding of the ordered file observation array

bundle_lock.path_policy: forward-slash relative paths below one caller-declared bundle root; reject absolute paths, parent traversal, duplicates, directories, and symlinks
bundle_lock.closure_digest: SHA-256 of canonical JSON encoding of the ordered file observation array

pass_policy: all six required dependency roles import successfully and expose at least one exact version observation
Linux exposes a concrete glibc version
all four worker thread variables equal one
CPU and cgroup observations are present
the complete non-generated E3FP source closure contains every required anchor
every explicitly named bundle file is a regular non-symlink file below the bundle root
non_claims: A passing attestation does not prove numerical equivalence across machines.
A passing attestation does not admit a dataset release or P1 training.
Compatibility with the frozen pipeline requires a separate 128-record golden comparison.
